description: This file contains a C# class 'TypeScriptParser' responsible for parsing TypeScript source code. It extracts imports, class definitions, methods, fields, and top-level functions, using regex patterns and token segmentation, to produce a structured representation of the source code.

classes.name: TypeScriptParser
classes.description: A parser class for extracting structured information from TypeScript source code, focusing on imports, classes, functions, methods, and fields.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses the provided TypeScript source code into a structured response containing imports, classes, functions, and diagnostics.

methods.name: Variables
methods.description: Extracts variables, specifically class fields, from the parse result.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript source code string from the parse result, optionally for a specified class.
